documents.name: Yinon Yahel Background
documents.source: Yinon Yahel is one of Israel's most acclaimed DJs and electronic music producers, internationally recognized in the house and progressive house scene. He has performed at legendary clubs and festivals around the world including Pacha Ibiza, Ministry of Sound London, and major events in Tel Aviv. His tracks have been supported by top DJs globally and have charted on international DJ charts. Yinon is known for his sophisticated, melodic take on progressive house music. He has released music on top electronic labels and runs his own label. His annual performances at Israeli beach clubs and New Year's Eve events are legendary. Yinon represents the thriving Tel Aviv electronic music scene on the world stage. He frequently collaborates with international and Israeli vocalists and producers. His DJ sets are known for their emotional journey and impeccable transitions. Yinon is also a sought-after remixer for international artists. He has released artist albums in addition to singles and EPs. He is a respected ambassador for Israeli music culture internationally. Yinon continues to evolve his sound while maintaining his signature style that blends emotion with dancefloor energy.
